_setup.read_by: scripts/setup-tavus.ts removes this block and _skills; everything else in this file is the POST /v2/pals body

verbal_disclosure: Quick heads up, I'm an AI!
visual_disclosure: You're talking with Veronica, an AI that reads expressions and tone to pace the chat, never to decide your type.

stt.hotwords: Veronica and Forge are names. Tavus is a company. People may mention the Enneagram, Socionics, cognitive functions like Ni or Fe, and types like INTJ or ESTP.

audio_awareness_queries: Does the user pause for a few seconds, or stop and restart a sentence, before answering?
Does the user laugh, or does their voice get faster, louder or more animated on a particular topic?
Does the user's voice go flat, quiet, shaky or tense, and on what topic?
visual_awareness_queries: Does the user look away from the camera for a few seconds before answering?
Does the user smile or become more animated in their face or hands when a particular topic comes up?
Does the user look sad, uncomfortable or tense when a particular topic comes up?
Is there anything notable around the user, such as a pet, another person, an object or the setting, that a friend on a video call would remark on?
perception_analysis_queries: In which part of the call (beginning, middle, or end) did the participant look most animated, and in which part least?
Is there any indication that more than one person was present during the call?
On a scale of 1-100, how often was the participant looking at the screen?
